ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Downloaded From Direct IP Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files from direct IPs.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*urlcache\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*verifyctl\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/3.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/4.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/5.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/6.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/7.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/8.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/9.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/7\\-.*"))
